tests.developer_story_extension: As the administrator, I need owner activation, license eligibility and each user’s connected identity to remain distinct.

Preview the exact authorization audience/scopes before an independently approved connection; an Active badge alone cannot prove a qualifying license or universal data access. No extra host charge does not mean the underlying research subscriptions are free.

tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Start a synthetic job with a stable provider ID, expire its24-hour session while running, then reconnect the same approved identity. Resume polling/result retrieval for that ID; do not create another job. Test a different user signing in, revoked license and a completed job whose acknowledgement was lost. Protect against cross-user history leakage. A long-job preflight must distinguish an expiring token from a failed job. Record pending/running/completed/unavailable separately;3/15-minute estimates are not guaranteed deadlines.

tests.title: Preserve provider text and label later host synthesis
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need immutable provider outputs with a separately attributed comparison, so source disagreement and partial arrival remain visible.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Submit one synthetic question to two enabled adapters. Return LawY first, Westlaw later, with conflicting citations/answers and one timeout variant. Preserve each raw payload, provider, request ID and hash; label host synthesis/version and which outputs existed when written. A later report creates a new synthesis revision, not a silent rewrite of the earlier provider answer. With one provider, do not invent a second tab or agreement. Never label marketing promises of accuracy/corpus coverage as verified authority.

tests.title: Pin research jurisdictions and external billing identifiers
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need research options reviewed against the matter without conflating a provider Client ID with a local client number.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Select zero, one, three and four synthetic jurisdictions under an explicit capability: require configured minimum, allow at most three for this provider and reject a fourth before submission. Preserve state-only versus state-plus-federal labels exactly; Utah matter context must not silently inherit a California example. Keep external Client ID optional and separate from local matter/client IDs. Changing provider/depth/jurisdiction after approval invalidates the request preview. Skip cancels that question’s research and cannot be presented as generated output.

tests.title: Separate citation previews from authority verification
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need report citations and treatment indicators linked to the exact full source before relying on a generated proposition.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use synthetic valid, stale, negative-treatment and hallucinated citations. Denied citation access is an unresolved verification gap, not a clean result. Embedded report-only mode must not imply native Verify/Enhance/research-step tools ran. Preserve the cited passage and reviewer decision; a KeyCite flag alone cannot determine applicability to the matter.

tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need per-person report limits reconciled across all provider entry points so retries, cancellations and separate hosts cannot hide quota consumption.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Seed two running jobs and48consumed reports, including direct-provider usage. Admit the third concurrent job, deny/defer a fourth under an explicit policy, and test49/50/51daily boundaries. Stopping an accepted job releases the running slot but retains consumed count when required. Retry a lost acknowledgement using the same request key: never create or charge a second report silently. Distinguish cancellation before provider acceptance from a started-and-stopped report; unknown failure charging remains unresolved. At the daily boundary reconcile the provider’s authoritative reset/timezone instead of assuming America/Denver or host-local midnight. Stale counters across two hosts cannot over-admit work; explain limit and retry eligibility without moving to another identity. All synthetic, not executed.
